note: LibreOffice application menu bar -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for File, Edit, View, Insert, Format, Styles, Sheet, Data, Tools, Window, and Help menus
LibreOffice toolbars -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for standard application controls like Save, Print, Undo, Redo, and formatting options
LibreOffice status bar -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for application state indicators like Ready, Page number, and Zoom level
Sheet tab list -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for sheet names (e.g., Sheet1, Sheet2) which are default application labels
